meta.summary: Strict controls for a scaling software company with envelopes set at 2.0x sector median, frontier access gated to CFO approval within 24 hours.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all AI subscriptions must be procured through the approved vendor catalog.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 75% consumed in a billing month
Team envelope exceeds 100% or company envelope reaches 90% consumed
Company envelope exceeds 110% or any agent kill threshold is breached

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $8,000 monthly Support envelope and is correctly tagged as production-inference, classifying as COGS under the project_tag rule.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 falls within the Data team envelope of $18,000/month and requires no escalation; routine pass under standard efficient-tier routing.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 20% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely a model version or prompt-length regression introduced in the deploy.
rationales.e4: Marketing employee card shows a third ChatGPT Team subscription this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 1 duplicate; the charge is rerouted to the approved vendor catalog per shadow AI policy.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate of $4,800 exceeds the $1,000 approval threshold; CFO sign-off is required before the ML Platform team may proceed.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 10-retry limit, and $47/hr, exceeding the $20/hr kill threshold; the loop is blocked, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier exception for the demo build is within the 24-hour approval window and the $100 max delta cap; routed to CFO for sign-off per the frontier exception rule.
rationales.e8: Junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; experimentation carve-out is preserved pending tag attribution within the 2-hour review window.
rationales.e9: Procurement agent dataset license at $499 falls within the $500 single-transaction ceiling and the data-licensing merchant scope; the purchase is approved under agent card policy.
rationales.e10: Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates the Sales tool already under contract at $1,400/year with 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to block. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling is reclassified from COGS to OpEx under the environment rule; the production-inference COGS tag was not applied, so the default OpEx class governs.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has passed the 75% burn alert threshold; pacing is flagged to the team lead but no throttle is triggered yet.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, agent guardrails, and classification rules reconciled with no open exceptions requiring escalation.
